text: Most of us are raised on one promise. Work hard, earn it, and the door opens. For some families it had a price.

Operation Varsity Blues showed millions of people, in black and white, that for some families the door had a price, the line was shorter, and the promise they had built their lives around carried an asterisk they were never shown.

text: Picture the student who never saw the side door, never knew it was there, and simply received a thinner envelope.
